title: Deformation of affine structures and the cohomology of Koszul-Vinberg algebras on the lie groups SO(2), H3(R) and Galilei group SGal(3)
summary: In this work, we compare the De Rham cohomology and the Koszul-Vinberg cohomology groups on the Lie groups SO(2), H3(R) and SGal(3). We model their interactions by constructing a three vertex directed graph connecting associative algebras, KV-cohomology, and Lie groups. By computing the exact dimensions of these complexes, we evaluate their algebraic quotient, which measures the gap separating global topological invariants from left-invariant flat affine structures.
